summary: The cited 802 FLOP/sample design is compared against a 16-line FDN, while its own discussion says FDN is cheaper at low order. FluidSynth's baseline has eight lines and one-pole damping, so the literature comparison did not establish a credible cost advantage. No performance claim is made.
title: Interleaved velvet-noise reverb cost screen
